title: Click Wheel
description: A white 2005 iPod you drive with your thumb. Circle the wheel and every detent clicks as the blue bar steps down the menu; press the centre to slide into Music, Albums, Abbey Road and land on Now Playing with the cover, a running progress bar and a beat in your ears.
intent: One faithful object finished to the edge: the touch wheel is the whole interface, a circular drag quantised into clicks, and the 320 by 240 screen behaves like the original, from sliding menus to the volume bar the wheel turns in Now Playing.
sources: herb reference board: Y2K found-footage montage (fa23bcd4), early-2000s media objects
